subject: general
question: What is the theme for World Soil Day 2024?

options.text: Soil and water, a source of life
Caring for Soils: Measure, Monitor, Manage
Halt soil salinization, enhance soil production
Keep soil alive, protect soil biodiversity

solution: The Correct Answer is __**Caring for Soils: Measure, Monitor, Manage.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** • **World Soil Day: 5 December.**
